tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Est.2.21; also called Bigthana at Est.6.2;
§ Bigthan = "in their wine-press"
a eunuch in king Ahasuerus' (Xerxes) court

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Bigthan or Bigthana, a eunuch of Xerxes
strongs_1890.derivation: or בִּגְתָנָא; of similar derivation to H903 (בִּגְתָא);
